Definition: to refuse, forbid, dissuade, or neutralize
BiblicalUsage: 1) to hinder, hold back, forbid, disallow, restrain, frustrate; 1a) (Qal) to hinder, hold back; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to restrain, forbid, frustrate; 1b2) to restrain, make averse, discourage
